caption: The drawing depicts a single round, shallow container with a matching lid placed centrally within the composition. The container and its lid are both rendered in shades of brown, with darker and lighter variations suggesting a marbled or textured surface. The lid features a carved or embossed pattern, consisting of a central rounded knob and radiating, symmetrical curved lines that end in small circular motifs, forming an ornate design. The object is positioned against a plain, cream-colored background that remains unshaded and free of additional objects or details. The entire scene is bordered by a thin, double-lined rectangular frame in a reddish-brown color.
title: Epaulette Box
